label: TP
reason: Both alerts are True Positives. Alert 1 (insecure-randomness): Math.random() generates non-cryptographic pseudo-random numbers used for session tokens (rememberMeKey), creating predictability risks. Alert 2 (XSS): User-supplied cookie values flow unencoded into HTTP responses via Cookie.getValue(), enabling script injection.

evidence.note: Math.random() produces weak PRNG for session token generation
Cookie values from clients concatenate unsanitized into response output
